name: approve-reads-the-request-first-with-command
why: The read of the request it is about to approve, with the command its credential was allowed for (ADR 26-09-30-854 §2).

job.purpose: discobox secret request approve <request-id> [--secret-id <secret-id>] [--use <use>]: approve a pending credential request (the server lets me answer only my own discoboxes' requests, within the delegation grants I hold)
facts: Discobox allowed this credential, for the request being judged, to the command: discobox secret request approve sreq_66te2j428g3dykhs
